title: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 could allow an attacker with local access to a container to extract sensitive…
description: IBM Cyber Fraud versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 contain a vulnerability that could allow an attacker with local access to a container to extract sensitive information. This issue arises from unrestrictive network policies within the affected versions. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4. No known exploits are reported in the wild, and no patches or fixes have been explicitly stated.
